intro: Wildmane Totem represents the third and final stage in Mull Thunderhorn's efforts to craft cleansing totems for Mulgore's poisoned wells. To restore the Wildmane Well, the ritual demands offerings taken from the territory's fiercest natural predators: prairie wolf alphas.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.
Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend. Do you have the teeth I asked for?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, friend. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
